title: Regular Conformal Equations for Matter with Nonzero Trace
exact_target: Can conformal field equations remain regular at the conformal boundary when the matter stress tensor has nonzero trace?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002148 (OWR-12009-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2012), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2012/37, pp. 2269--2333. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 47.
Friedrich et al., conformal methods review (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The question is a construction programme across matter models. It does not say that one fixed rescaling must work for every imaginable nonzero-trace tensor; admissible matter equations must be specified as in the source.
